nodes.label: Hover-Only Interactive Elements
nodes.author: Copyright 2026 Google LLC
nodes.rationale: When Opacity is 0, set pointer-events: none to avoid click blocking.

nodes.label: Active/Open State Stability
nodes.author: Copyright 2026 Google LLC
nodes.rationale: Ensure button stays visible when its associated menu is active using aria-expanded="true" or :focus-within.

nodes.label: Combobox, Select, and Multiselect Headless Patterns
nodes.norm_label: combobox, select, and multiselect headless patterns

nodes.label: Styling Third-Party & JIT-Generated Components
nodes.rationale: Avoid ::ng-deep; instead target template-defined sibling/child elements directly.

nodes.label: State Propagation in Effects
nodes.rationale: DO NOT use effects to propagate state. Use computed() or linkedSignal() instead to avoid ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenChecked.

nodes.label: Host Binding
nodes.rationale: Preferred approach over legacy decorators for binding attributes, classes, and styles to component host elements.

nodes.label: Signal-based Inputs
nodes.rationale: Preferred over legacy @Input() for better reactivity and compile-time type safety.

nodes.label: Linked Signal
nodes.rationale: Used for writable state that is linked to a source state and resets when the source changes.

nodes.label: Lazy Loading
nodes.rationale: Keeps the initial bundle size small by deferring feature area loading.

nodes.label: Automatic Migrations
nodes.rationale: Using official schematics reduces human error and speeds up modernization of control flow, signals, and inject.

nodes.label: Function-based Outputs
nodes.rationale: Preferred over legacy @Output() and EventEmitter for cleaner APIs.

nodes.label: Reactive Forms
nodes.rationale: Provides a model-driven approach that is more scalable and testable than template-driven forms.

nodes.label: Resource API
nodes.rationale: Integrates async fetching into the signals state graph, handling cancellation via abortSignal.

nodes.label: RouterTestingHarness
nodes.rationale: Ensures actual router configuration, guards, and resolvers are tested instead of mocking the Router.

nodes.label: Signal Forms
nodes.rationale: Provides a reactive, type-safe, and model-driven way to manage form state using Angular Signals.

nodes.label: FieldState Calling Rule
nodes.rationale: Must call a FormField as a function to obtain its FieldState and access its reactivity signals.

nodes.label: Reactive Contexts
nodes.rationale: Only track signal dependencies synchronously; async steps require pre-caching signal values.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS v4
nodes.rationale: Avoids old @tailwind directives, relying on CSS theme variables and PostCSS configuration.

nodes.label: Zoneless Testing
nodes.rationale: Zoneless components require waiting for stable states using fixture.whenStable() instead of triggering detectChanges() synchronously.
